graph_residual_adapter.definition: seasonal nearest-source residual propagation over the frozen water-only coastal graph, using only honest inner-validation residuals generated from inner-training labels
graph_residual_adapter.architecture_change: target-residual graph adapter rather than Issue-42 label-free four-neighbour ST96
graph_residual_adapter.inner_source_split: complete groups; half sources and half graph-selection
graph_residual_adapter.fallback: zero correction when unreachable or unsupported

uncertainty_scale_head.definition: fixed ExtraTrees log-absolute-error scale head trained on honest inner-validation residuals, followed by outer-training-only standardized grouped conformal calibration
uncertainty_scale_head.control: Issue-61 prediction-stratified grouped conformal widths on the identical point prediction

evaluation.point_gate: at least 1% RMSE improvement in two intended transfer schemes with paired grouped bootstrap upper MSE difference below zero, no scheme regression above 2%, and no boundary artifact
evaluation.uncertainty_gate: improve WIS and fixed-coverage risk in geographic, whole-region, and forward without coverage below 0.85, mean width inflation above 25%, or point-score change
evaluation.ensemble_gate: inner residual trigger plus the same outer point gate

artifacts.caption_policy: full caption immediately below every figure in REPORT.md
